title: Docker SIGTERM leaves active worker jobs leased
description: Comprehensive local Pi Compose E2E on 2026-06-01 showed the asyncio cancellation fix for MM-RAG-xcp does not cover actual Docker stop behavior. In isolated project mmrag-e2e-20260601193547, a second MCP ingest job (1f7a7427-895f-47b7-adda-33a71de95bc2) was running at stage='normalize'. After docker stop -t 10 mmrag-e2e-20260601193547-mmrag-worker-1, the jobs row remained status='running' with runner_id='311e4f39-aae0-41e3-9595-a45d00531496' and runner_heartbeat_at='2026-06-01T23:44:42.196Z' instead of being queued/released. This would strand in-flight Pironman jobs until JOB_LEASE_STALE_SECONDS expires during container stop/restart. Fix should install SIGTERM/SIGINT handling around the worker CLI/asyncio runner so Docker stop cancels run_worker, lets run_pipeline release its lease, and exits cleanly before Docker's grace timeout. Add an integration-style test or subprocess test that sends SIGTERM to the worker process while a fake long job is active and asserts the job is immediately queued/reclaimable.
close_reason: Fixed by installing SIGTERM/SIGINT handling around the worker runner and terminating child subprocesses on cancellation. Verified with local Pi Compose docker stop/restart probe: active job returned to queued with runner_id/heartbeat cleared, then restarted worker reclaimed it.

title: ingest wait_ms timeout cancels the in-process pipeline
description: handle_ingest creates an asyncio task for run_pipeline, then awaits asyncio.wait_for(pipeline_task, timeout=wait_ms/1000). asyncio.wait_for cancels the task on timeout, despite the comment saying the pipeline should keep running. With runner leases, a timed-out ingest can leave the job in status=running with a fresh runner_heartbeat_at and no live runner; mmrag-worker will skip it until JOB_LEASE_STALE_SECONDS elapses. Repro probe: monkeypatch run_pipeline to sleep, call handle_ingest(IngestInput(..., wait_ms=1)), and the fake task receives CancelledError while the response is in_progress. Fix should shield the task from wait_for cancellation and add a regression test that timed-out sync-if-fast ingest keeps the pipeline task alive or is immediately worker-claimable.
close_reason: Fixed bug sweep set: shielded timed-out ingest tasks, restored audio-only WAV extraction, exposed and pre-filtered ask time_range, made sqlite-vec core for schema init, sanitized FTS punctuation queries, implemented worker concurrency cap, cleaned duplicate URL downloads, and added regression tests. Validated with uv lock --check, make lint, and make test.

title: Fix duplicate async ingest runner race in MCP+worker deployment
description: During local Pi-shaped Docker E2E project mmrag-e2e-20260601164356, MCP ingest with wait_ms=0 created an in-process run_pipeline task while mmrag-worker simultaneously picked up the same queued job. Both started fetch for job 102cba9b-561d-471f-a6e1-f4eb41b09cd3 within ~70ms. One yt-dlp download succeeded; the other failed renaming /data/assets/raw/8qQW4LTWgtc.mp4.part to .mp4 and wrote error_kind=source_unreachable. The MCP-side runner later completed the pipeline and marked status=done, but the jobs row still retained error_kind/error_message. Fix deployment-safe job ownership/claiming so only one runner can execute a job and done jobs do not retain stale error fields.
close_reason: Fixed with job runner leases: added migration 0006 runner_id/runner_heartbeat_at, atomic runner claim, lease refresh/release, worker selection for queued/stale jobs only, and stale error clearing on successful completion. Validated by unit tests, full make test/lint, rebuilt Docker image, container lease regression, and clean Docker MCP+worker E2E rerun.

title: sqlite-vec asset_id scoping under-delivers: k= is a global pre-filter
description: sqlite-vec MATCH applies k= as a GLOBAL KNN pre-filter, so an asset_id WHERE clause runs AFTER the top-k cut. The moment the index holds more than one asset, asset_id-scoped search silently returns fewer than k rows or misses the asset entirely. Fix: add an auxiliary column to the vec0 declaration (e.g. +asset_id TEXT) and filter on it inside the MATCH query instead of an outer WHERE. Affects vec_frames, vec_scenes, vec_transcript and the search handler. Required before M5 multi-tenant deployment. Recreated after beads re-init; previously tracked as MM-RAG-687.
close_reason: Completed M4 evidence packs with synth opt-in, content_items foundation, and sqlite-vec metadata-column asset scoping regression coverage.

title: Worker shutdown leaves active jobs leased for an hour
description: When run_worker is cancelled it cancels active run_pipeline tasks and gathers return_exceptions. run_pipeline only records normal Exception subclasses; asyncio.CancelledError is allowed to escape without clearing runner_id or runner_heartbeat_at. The job remains status='running' with a fresh heartbeat, and a restarted worker will skip it until JOB_LEASE_STALE_SECONDS (3600s) expires. On Pironman deploy/restart this can freeze an ingest for up to an hour. Fix should mark active jobs queued/stale on graceful worker shutdown or have run_pipeline handle cancellation by clearing the lease before re-raising. Add a regression cancelling a worker task mid-job and verifying the job is immediately reclaimable or queued.
close_reason: Fixed by handling run_pipeline cancellation with immediate lease release/requeue and regression coverage.

title: Pipeline resume reruns the last completed stage
description: run_pipeline treats jobs.stage as the last completed stage because _persist_state writes it after each successful stage. The resume skip logic excludes the matching stage (completed_stage != stage), so a job persisted at stage='embed' reruns embed instead of starting at summarize; the same applies to other completed stages. On Pi this wastes CPU and can rewrite expensive OCR/vector artifacts after a crash or worker restart. Fix should either skip every stage whose index is <= the persisted completed stage, or explicitly persist separate current/completed stage state. Add a regression that seeds a job at a completed stage and asserts _run_stage is not called for that stage.
close_reason: Fixed by treating jobs.stage as the last completed stage and skipping stages up to and including it on resume, with regression coverage.

title: MCP hybrid search loads SigLIP model in transport service
description: The Pi E2E after the queue-only ingest fix showed ingest stages running in mmrag-worker, but a later hybrid search/ask still logged embed.model_load/embed.model_ready in mmrag-mcp. handle_search encodes vector queries by importing _encode_texts_sync from the embed stage, which loads the full SigLIP/open_clip model in the MCP process. On Pironman this can duplicate the visual model in both mmrag-worker and mmrag-mcp, undermining the transport-light split and risking memory pressure during search while ingest is active. Fix should choose a Pi-safe strategy: route vector query encoding through the worker, add a lightweight query encoder mode, make MCP default to FTS-only on constrained profiles, or otherwise cap/document model residency with tests/log checks.
close_reason: Fixed by adding MMRAG_QUERY_VECTOR_ENABLED and disabling query vector encoding in Pi Compose so MCP hybrid search does not load SigLIP/open_clip on constrained transport services.

title: MCP ingest runs pipeline inside MCP service instead of worker
description: The local Docker E2E showed a wait_ms=0 MCP ingest executing fetch/normalize/scene/transcribe/OCR/embed stages in the mmrag-mcp container while mmrag-worker only logged worker.start. handle_ingest always creates an in-process run_pipeline task, so the Pi Compose split does not actually keep heavy ingest work out of the MCP service. Fix should decide whether HTTP MCP ingest should only enqueue and let mmrag-worker claim jobs, or document this single-process behavior and adjust the Pi deployment model accordingly.
close_reason: Fixed by adding MMRAG_INGEST_INLINE, setting Pi Compose to false, and validating Docker E2E shows stages run in mmrag-worker while mmrag-mcp only enqueues/polls.

title: PDF ingestion omits embedded images and table content items
description: The PDF document path uses pypdf page.extract_text only and emits text content items. It never emits image items for embedded images or table items for PDF tables, leaving the document-ingestion acceptance surface incomplete for PDFs. Fix should add image/table extraction with fixtures, or explicitly narrow the documented/bead acceptance criteria so PDF ingestion is text-only.

title: Qdrant vector backend silently returns no results
description: QdrantBackend.frame_hits and QdrantBackend.transcript_hits currently return [] unconditionally. Setting MMRAG_VECTOR_BACKEND=qdrant silently removes vector results from vector and hybrid searches instead of querying Qdrant or failing loudly. Fix should either implement Qdrant collection/query behavior with tests, or reject qdrant mode at startup/config time until it is actually supported.

title: hybrid_graph drops graph expansions when base hits fill top_k
description: _with_graph_expansion appends graph-expanded hits after all base hits and stops once len(merged) reaches inp.top_k. Because handle_search truncates base hybrid/fts hits to inp.top_k before graph expansion, any query with a full base result set returns zero graph-expanded evidence and hybrid_graph collapses to hybrid. Fix should reserve expansion capacity or fuse/rerank graph hits before final top_k, with a regression where base hits fill top_k but at least one graph neighbor is still returned.

title: default package install cannot initialize current schema without m3-visual
description: pyproject keeps sqlite-vec in the optional m3-visual extra, but migration 0003 unconditionally creates vec0 virtual tables. In an environment installed from the default package dependencies only, connect() logs sqlite_vec.unavailable and apply_migrations()/mmrag init-db will fail when CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE ... USING vec0 runs. The Makefile hides this by running commands with --extra m3-visual, and Docker installs m3-visual, but SDK/library users following the default install path get a CLI that imports but cannot initialize the DB. Fix should either make sqlite-vec a core runtime dependency for the current v1 schema or gate/defer vector migrations with a clear error/docs path.
close_reason: Fixed bug sweep set: shielded timed-out ingest tasks, restored audio-only WAV extraction, exposed and pre-filtered ask time_range, made sqlite-vec core for schema init, sanitized FTS punctuation queries, implemented worker concurrency cap, cleaned duplicate URL downloads, and added regression tests. Validated with uv lock --check, make lint, and make test.

title: ask time_range is not usable through MCP and filters too late
description: AskInput and docs expose time_range, but src/mmrag/mcp_server.py's ask tool signature does not accept time_range, so Streamable HTTP/stdio MCP clients cannot ask timestamp-scoped questions even though README/docs show ask(question, asset_id=None, time_range=None, ...). REST can pass it, but handle_ask applies _filter_time_range after handle_search has already limited results to top_k, so valid in-range evidence can be dropped before filtering. Fix should expose time_range on the MCP tool, validate range ordering, and make retrieval time-aware enough that asking about a timestamp does not return empty evidence merely because earlier top_k hits were outside the range.
close_reason: Fixed bug sweep set: shielded timed-out ingest tasks, restored audio-only WAV extraction, exposed and pre-filtered ask time_range, made sqlite-vec core for schema init, sanitized FTS punctuation queries, implemented worker concurrency cap, cleaned duplicate URL downloads, and added regression tests. Validated with uv lock --check, make lint, and make test.

title: audio-only ingest never produces transcripts
description: The project advertises video/audio/image ingestion, but normalize() only extracts audio when vstream is not None: if not audio_path.exists() and vstream is not None. For a valid WAV fixture, normalize writes an audio-only mezzanine.mp4 but returns audio_path=None, so transcribe() returns no segments and audio-only files are indexed as silent. Local repro with tests/fixtures/sample.wav produced {'audio_path': None, 'duration_s': 3.0, 'width': None, 'height': None}. Fix should extract 16 kHz mono WAV whenever the probe reports an audio stream, independent of video presence, and add an audio-only normalize/pipeline regression.
close_reason: Fixed bug sweep set: shielded timed-out ingest tasks, restored audio-only WAV extraction, exposed and pre-filtered ask time_range, made sqlite-vec core for schema init, sanitized FTS punctuation queries, implemented worker concurrency cap, cleaned duplicate URL downloads, and added regression tests. Validated with uv lock --check, make lint, and make test.

title: OCR per-frame timeout abandons future but does not kill tesseract subprocess
description: The ocr stage wraps each frame in a 10s asyncio.wait_for over a single-worker ThreadPoolExecutor. On timeout the future is abandoned but the underlying tesseract subprocess keeps running, so worst case on an N-frame video is N times the actual tesseract runtime, not N times 10s. Mitigation: shell tesseract out via the pipeline subprocess wrapper (run, with SIGTERM to SIGKILL escalation) instead of pytesseract in-process, so the timeout actually kills the process. Operational concern on Pi-class hardware with large frames. Noted as follow-up in ocr.py docstring.

title: Status shows previous stage during long pipeline stages
description: During the Pironman production burn-in, worker logs showed stage.start for embed at 2026-06-02T01:03:22Z and active CPU usage near three cores, but the MCP status tool and jobs row continued reporting stage=ocr progress=0.75 until embed completed several minutes later. This makes long-running stages look stale or stuck to clients. Fix should persist stage/progress at stage start or expose an active_stage/heartbeat update, with a regression using a mocked long-running stage.
close_reason: Fixed by persisting active stage/progress at stage start while retaining last_completed_stage in pipeline_state_json for resume semantics; regression verifies cancellation during active stage retries that stage. Validation: focused job lease tests, make lint, make test.

title: Search time_range does not filter content-item or graph hits
description: SearchInput supports time_range and the transcript, scene, and vector streams apply it before ranking, but _content_items_hits ignores time_range and _with_graph_expansion calls expand_search_hits without any time filter. A REST caller using search(time_range=...) or a future MCP caller after time_range is exposed can receive content_items or hybrid_graph hits outside the requested window, especially because content_items are merged into fts/hybrid results after the filtered streams. Fix should thread time_range through _content_items_hits and graph expansion, apply the same overlap predicate to content_items.start_s/end_s, and add regressions for fts/hybrid/hybrid_graph searches where out-of-range content_items would otherwise win.
close_reason: Fixed by applying time_range to content-item FTS hits and graph expansion, with regression coverage.

title: MCP search tool omits time_range parameter
description: SearchInput and handle_search support time_range filtering, and REST callers can send it, but the MCP search tool signature only exposes query, asset_id, top_k, and mode. Tailnet agents using MCP cannot perform time-bounded search directly even though the retrieval path supports it; only ask exposes time_range. Fix should add time_range to the MCP search tool signature, pass it into SearchInput, and add a tool-schema regression similar to the ask time_range test.
close_reason: Fixed by adding time_range to the MCP search tool signature and SearchInput construction, with tool-schema coverage.

title: SBT push can post invalid URL for local assets
description: _sbt_payload sets url to asset.source_url or asset.mezzanine_path or asset.metadata_json. For local document/audio/image assets with push_to_sbt=true, this can POST a local filesystem path or {} as the URL even though SBT idempotency is keyed by URL. Fix should skip SBT push for non-URL assets or include a separate source field and validate the URL before posting.

title: Document chunker can emit arbitrarily oversized chunks
description: The document _chunks helper only splits on sentence boundaries. A long run of text without .?! can exceed max_chars by arbitrary size because the oversized sentence is assigned to buf unchanged. This can create very large content_items rows and graph/topic labels for minified HTML, OCR-like text, or long unpunctuated Markdown/text. Fix should hard-split long sentences/paragraphs and add a regression for long unpunctuated document text.

title: Office ingestion only supports DOCX
description: is_document_source only includes .docx among Office formats. Files such as .pptx, .xlsx, .xls, .ppt, and .rtf are not detected as documents and will fall into the media normalize/ffprobe path or fail unclearly, despite the document-ingestion plan mentioning Office files. Fix should either add parsers for the supported Office formats or add a clear unsupported-file error/source_type handling path and update docs accordingly.

title: duplicate URL ingest leaves raw downloads behind
description: fetch() moves a URL download into the hash-keyed asset directory only when raw_dest does not already exist. If the same URL/content is ingested again after the canonical raw file exists, yt-dlp downloads into assets/raw, content_hash matches, raw_dest exists, and fetch() returns the canonical raw_path without deleting or moving the newly downloaded temporary/raw file. This can accumulate duplicate video files under MMRAG_DATA_DIR/assets/raw and may confuse later yt-dlp runs that use the same output template. Fix should clean up the duplicate URL download when raw_dest already exists, with a regression that repeated URL fetches leave no extra file in assets/raw.

Validated with uv lock --check, make lint, and make test.

title: MMRAG_WORKER_CONCURRENCY setting is ignored
description: Settings exposes worker_concurrency, .env.example documents MMRAG_WORKER_CONCURRENCY as the parallel pipeline job cap, and docker-compose.pi.yml sets it to 1 for Pi safety. The worker loop never reads get_settings().worker_concurrency; _claim_pending always returns up to 16 jobs and run_worker processes them sequentially one at a time. This makes the env var misleading: increasing it does nothing, and the code does not explicitly enforce the configured cap. Fix should either implement bounded parallelism from Settings.worker_concurrency or remove/rename the setting and docs so deploy operators are not relying on a no-op knob.
